Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You explain the price through specific cost shares—it sounds like recovering underlying costs is central to your offer. We can support continuity through a longer commitment in return for a lower price grounded in those costs. Please share your cost-breakdown XLSX; what scope would that commitment create to reduce the individual price elements?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -8.5% from 2024-11 to 2025-10 (idx:AS-14404@2024-11, idx:AS-14404@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month volume of 23,700 units per year.
While company policy prevents us from sharing internal cost breakdowns, we must include the AS-14404 index clause as we cannot offer a fixed price over a 24-month period.
With this index clause and the extended contract term, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.30 per unit.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You repeatedly emphasise index protection and welcome our longer commitment; it sounds like dependable business without unpriced material risk matters most to you. We want a durable agreement in which sharing that risk translates into a more competitive base price. What reduction can you offer in exchange for faster payment and material-cost protection?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.87 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
